text:
Alex: quick preflight handoff — heads up on last night's short embed blip in eu-west. sev2 pager for embeddings-5xx between ~03:12-03:25 UTC, root cause was an autoscaler mis-schedule + kv-cache pressure. mitigated by temporarily pinning the autoscaler, bumping replicas, and rolling back the cache eviction change. no customer data lost, some requests retried.

incident-bot: [AUTO] Page triggered: embeddings-5xx-rate-high (sev2) — 2026-03-14T03:12:18Z — pager routed to #eng-oncall.

Alex: current state: error rate back down to ~0.08% (was ~4.2% at peak), p95 latency returned to baseline. alert threshold still flapping a bit; we left a medium alert on to watch for regressions. dashboards: https://console.redwood/inference/dashboards/embeddings-eu-west

Mira: thanks — I'm taking primary for the morning shift. Sam you still secondary until 20:00 UTC?

Sam: yep I'm secondary until 20:00 UTC. I'm on-call and available. quick Q: any ongoing mitigations I should keep in place?

Alex: leave the autoscaler pinned to the safe policy (policy id: autoscaler-safe-v2) until we finish the postmortem. do not re-enable eviction change without sign-off from eng-runtime. runbook is pinned: https://runbooks.redwood/embeddings-cache-throttle (see section "Quick rollback").

Mira: noted. where's the fast-check command if we see another spike?

Alex: quick live checks:
```
# check pod health and replica count
kubectl -n inference get deploy embedding-service -o wide
# tail recent 5xx logs
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/embedding-service --since=10m | grep "HTTP 5.." | tail -n 50
```
If 5xx > 1% -> runbook step 2: disable autoscaler and `kubectl scale deploy embedding-service --replicas=8` then hit the cache-clear API: `curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/embeddings/clear-prefix-cache -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY"`

Tay: FYI I have a calendar conflict 19:30-21:00 UTC tonight — might create a coverage gap if nobody swaps. can someone cover that chunk?

Julian: I can cover 19:30-21:00 UTC tonight. happy to be tertiary on standby.

Sam: thanks Julian. Mira, can we update the rotation doc and add Julian as tertiary for that window?

Mira: done — updated rotation doc and added Julian. link: https://docs.redwood/ops/rotations#2026-03-14. I also created follow-up ticket INC-1234 to track postmortem and the autoscaler fix. assigned to @alex and @julian.

Alex: action items before I sign off: 1) snapshot autoscaler configs (`gcloud secrets versions add autoscaler-safe-v2`), 2) attach recent flamegraph to INC-1234, 3) mark the temporary alert note in the alerting dashboard. I'll do 1+2 in next 20m.

Mira: thanks. small checklist for whoever gets a pager: 1) check embedding error rate and p95 on dashboard, 2) run the tail logs command, 3) if >1% 5xx escalate to step 2 in runbook and ping #eng-oncall with `@oncall` + short summary, 4) if customer impact suspected open a support incident.

Sam: copied. I'll keep watches on the alert for the next 4h and will escalate if it reappears.

incident-bot: [AUTO] Alert suppression set by Alex for embeddings-5xx-rate-high until 2026-03-14T12:00:00Z (reason: mitigations in flight).

Alex: I'm reachable on pager for 30m, after that Mira is the primary. leaving the thread now — :thumbsup: Good luck team.
